definitions.short: Jered , the name of an antediluvian, and of an Israelite
definitions.full: H3382. Yered יֶ֫רֶד proper name, masculine 1. son of Mehall'el, fourth Generation from Seth Gen 5:16 , 18 , 19 , 20 ; יָ֑רֶד 5:15 ; 1Chr 1:2 ; ᵐ5 Ιαρεδ (see Lag BN 77 ). 2 יֶרֶד man of Judah 1Chr 4:18 ; ᵐ5 id.

occurrences.englishText: Mahalalel lived sixty-five years, then became the father of Jared.
Mahalalel lived after he became the father of Jared eight hundred thirty years, and became the father of other sons and daughters.
Jared lived one hundred sixty-two years, then became the father of Enoch.
Jared lived after he became the father of Enoch eight hundred years, and became the father of other sons and daughters.
All of the days of Jared were nine hundred sixty-two years, then he died.
His wife the Jewess bore Jered the father of Gedor, Heber the father of Soco, and Jekuthiel the father of Zanoah. These are the sons of Bithiah the daughter of Pharaoh, whom Mered took.
